repeated_original20.claim: Descriptive whole-core-versus-reused-feature equivalence check; no numerical tolerance or silent substitution.

numerical_gate.criterion: Strict lower future contrast MSE than zero and old128, and positive target alignment, for every one of four fixed held-out noises.
numerical_gate.scope: Held-out noise on one seen scene; no visual or generalization claim.

limitations: No model, backward or native feature replay. Source and saved counts support12 feature extractions; only66 head outputs are retained.
Numeric gate is separate from raw artifact integrity and from descriptive cross-run equality.
Four held-out noises on one seen scene do not establish successful visual actions, camera control or scene generalization.
FP64 record roundoff tolerance never changes the strict numerical gate inequalities.
